policy.purpose: Declare verifier bundles and their minimum sufficient proof tier.
policy.default_rule: Use the lowest tier that proves the claim; tier labels are not pass/fail evidence.
policy.execution_rule: This manifest is not a runner. Follow project AGENTS.md, release gates, account checks, and approval rules before running commands.

tiers.tier_1_local_fast: Local lint, parser, unit, or shape checks with no external service.
tiers.tier_2_local_integrated: Local integration checks that may require local app services or local test records.
tiers.tier_3_staging_or_private: Staging, private platform, sandbox, or authenticated non-live checks.
tiers.tier_4_live_or_external: Live, customer-facing, publish, billing, public account, marketplace, deployment, or other external-impact gates.

bundles.scope: Checks that this persistent Hermes task scaffold has the expected project files, lane board, verifier manifest, and capability root pointers.
bundles.approval_required: no, if run locally on Banebook
bundles.evidence_artifact: terminal output in the active agent session or a future workstream handoff
risk_triggers: raise the tier if this starts touching external accounts, messaging delivery, live services, or another Hermes profile
proves: the local project scaffold shape matches the current project validator
bundles.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove any external task delivery, remote host setup, or production system behavior.

bundles.scope: Checks the project-local capability root graph shape.
bundles.approval_required: no, if run locally on Banebook
bundles.evidence_artifact: terminal output in the active agent session or a future workstream handoff
risk_triggers: raise the tier if capability validation starts reading external systems or private runtime state
proves: the project-local capability root has no validator errors
bundles.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove that every referenced external capability or machine-level root is current.

bundles.scope: Checks the project connection/control capability root graph shape, including browser/CDP and agent-only browser cards.
bundles.approval_required: no, if run locally on Banebook
bundles.evidence_artifact: terminal output in the active agent session or a future lane handoff
risk_triggers: raise the tier if validation starts reading private browser/session state or external accounts
proves: the connection/control capability root has no validator errors
bundles.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove live account access or authority to perform external actions.

bundles.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove the user has accepted every proposed permission tier.

bundles.evidence_artifact: terminal output in the active agent session or a future lane handoff
risk_triggers: raise the tier if validation starts reading secrets or runtime caches
proves: the agent-infrastructure capability root has no validator errors
bundles.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove remote services, account access, or future launcher state.

bundles.command: hermes-agent-brave-status && hermes-agent-cdp eval '({title: document.title, url: location.href})'
bundles.scope: Checks that the local agent-only Brave profile is running on CDP port 9223 and can read current page state.
bundles.mutation: read-only if the browser is already running; launching it is a local reversible GUI process
bundles.approval_required: no for status/read checks; ask before using desktop-coordinate input or logging into sensitive accounts
bundles.evidence_artifact: terminal output in the active agent session or `agent-lanes/connections-control-HANDOFF.md`
risk_triggers: raise tier and ask before using logged-in sensitive accounts, submissions, uploads, or desktop input automation
proves: agent-only browser CDP endpoint exists and page state can be read
bundles.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not prove external account login state or approval for any external action.
